title: Gastly to Haunter to Gengar evolution
narration: Gastly is getting ready for something big.
Its body starts to glow. Gastly is evolving!
Gastly evolved into Haunter, and the power keeps growing!
And now Haunter becomes Gengar! Who is your favourite Ghost-type Pokemon? Comment below!
